protocol.central_claim: shared cross-output source errors and shared historical R can retain usable local EV response
protocol.synthetic_model: exact declared linear squared-drop working model; no nonlinear AC/device dynamics
protocol.source_location: fixed common-trunk endpoint; g=a*ones(3), not arbitrary hidden position
protocol.coefficient_units: squared-voltage pu / power pu; includes factor 2
protocol.evaluation_noise: independent uniform within +/-0.8 declared coordinate bound
protocol.information_timing: fixed port1/protocol before evaluation; no policy selected from heldout truth
protocol.reset_comparison: same old+new observations; independent R per batch; max batch slack
protocol.objective: minimum extra max absolute squared-drop residual beyond measurement box; no probability inferred
